reviewer: Independent native visual critic, bounded second review of the repaired signature presentation
review_context: This is a rereview with the Wish already revealed in round 1, not a second blind experiment. Original blind observations and failed round-1 verdict are preserved. Current stills and newly decoded ordered GIF frames were inspected before reading STATE-SEQUENCE.md. Parent decoded the actual GIF after local child Python execution failed; the critic independently viewed the images.
blind_held_read: Original blind read: a shallow round tabletop puzzle/game board with coinlike counters; liftable tray appearance, actual scale unknown.
blind_form_read: Original blind read: a broad thin circular base supports a raised annular platform and separate central disc; recessed circular seats contain low counters and two taller stacks. Recognizably volumetric but strongly planar.
blind_subjects_read: Original blind read: abstract discs, sockets, concentric rings and tally/dot markings; no figurative subjects.
blind_action_read: Original blind read: turn concentric surfaces and rearrange or stack counters. Rereview before the new explanatory file: revised stills add visible selective lifting; revised ordered motion adds carrier-to-carrier travel and final reseating.
blind_relationship_read: Original blind read: two concentric counter groups share one stationary rim with repeated station markings; stacks and inscribed faces distinguish counters. Rereview shows selected counters changing lanes while other counters remain at their post-turn seats.
anti_generic_signature_read: Original blind read identified nested moving surfaces, recessed seats, stacks and fixed tallies. The revised ordered images additionally show a distinct selective transfer after collective transport, making the two-stage tactile interaction specific and recognizable.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: A coherent ordinary tabletop physical game with a fixed shore and two concentric carriers
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: The broad shallow base, central disc and annulus are discernible in both review rounds; fixed peripheral marks remain still throughout the animation.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Each carrier visibly transports its seated passengers as a group
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Current frames 00–05 show counters and their recess patterns rotating together relative to the fixed shore, with the two carriers moving by different amounts.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Abstract boats share locations through stacking
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Low cylindrical counters occupy circular recesses, with visible stack-height differences before and after transfer. Figurative boats are unnecessary for the revealed Wish.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Fixed harbor rewards are separate from moving passenger carriers
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Peripheral dot groups remain fixed while the carriers turn. Exact reward values remain small and require a closer view or written instructions.

critical_form_requirements.requirement: Selected boats cross to the other carrier one harbor clockwise after collective transport
critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Current frames 06–15 show a subset lift away, travel, and reseat at changed radial and angular locations while other counters stay seated. The outer-right stack location empties and an inner-right stack appears; the inner-front stack reduces to one while an outer lower-left counter appears. Comparison with the already-revealed rule and then STATE-SEQUENCE.md resolves the displayed adjacent clockwise destinations. The transfer itself is directly visible rather than inferred from text.

largest_risk: Small engraved identity marks and peripheral pips remain difficult to read, so tracking every individual passenger or verifying exact scoring from the render alone is difficult. The uncaptioned signature pair shows scoring and mid-transfer rather than a complete round; its meaning is completed by the ordered animation and instructions.
resolution: The specific round-1 presentation blocker is resolved: actual revised motion visibly adds selective carrier-to-carrier transfer and final seating after collective rotation. No further CAD or presentation repair is required for this bounded visual verdict. The signature-experience verdict concerns the recognizable tactile transport-and-cross interaction, not a claim that secret selection, direction exhaustion, reward arithmetic or complete rules can be learned from an uncaptioned animation. Finished-product desirability is this critic's visual judgment, not evidence of family enjoyment.
blind_motion_read: Rereview observation made before new explanatory text, with prior Wish knowledge: frames 00–05 rotate groups of seated counters relative to the fixed rim; 06–10 lift a subset while others remain seated; 11–15 carry that subset to different radial lanes and angular positions and seat it again. The final outer-right stack is gone and an inner-right stack appears; inner-front stack height reduces. This now visibly demonstrates selective transfer rather than rotation alone. Original blind motion read remains preserved separately.
motion_scope: The ordered animation demonstrates collective carrier transport followed by selective hand-transfer results consistent with the revealed clockwise-crossing rule. Simultaneous floating counters are an explanatory representation of hand handling, not self-actuation. The review does not certify a collision-free simultaneous travel path, secret contribution arithmetic, scoring correctness, physical clearances, friction, print success, durability, ease of handling or human enjoyment.
contrast_assessment: The pale, outline-heavy still style and small marks are legibility limitations, not blocking defects: base, concentric carriers, seats, stacks, lifted passengers and final cross-carrier relocation remain visible.
